static_traits.name: Lin Wei
static_traits.social_status: 与舞队有亲密朋友群体，但因对比赛的Anxiety而疏离，减少与家人朋友交流
static_traits.medical_history: 此前not yet出现类似心理问题；not yet接受过心理治疗或咨询；without显著躯体疾病
static_traits.language_features: 表达清晰、逻辑尚可，语气消极与Anxiety突出，坦诚但对自我暴露有所顾虑，配合度较好

basic_info.main_problem: 我因为竞技舞队最近两次比赛失利而感到overwhelmed和Anxiety，尽管我们仍然总排名第一，这让我相信整个赛季都毁了。
basic_info.core_demands: 这些Anxiety和失望影响了我对舞蹈的享受和整体心理健康。我只想not再总觉得自己是失败者，能够重新享受跳舞并减少Anxiety。

special_situations.event: The dance team lost the last two competitions (but still ranks first overall)
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果not能保持连胜，就说明赛季失败、我也失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Tries to focus on the positive and practice mindfulness to counter negative emotions

special_situations.event: 临近或讨论即将到来的比赛
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 如果再输一次就证明我让大家失望、I am a failure
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Presets the worst outcome in advance and repeatedly rehearses failure scenes to 'be mentally prepared'
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: We will definitely lose again; I will disappoint everyone again.

special_situations.event: 在练习时或他人提起比赛表现
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 只有完美发挥并取胜才说明我够好；not完美就等于失败
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Raises the standards for herself and intensifies self-criticism, while avoiding talking in depth with others lest she appear weak
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I am not good enough，我本该做得更多。

special_situations.event: Realizes the team still ranks first overall but has had recent losses
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: 正面表现not重要，最近的失利才是真正的证明
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: 只关注负面结果，忽略或negate积极反馈
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: 这些好的成绩都not算数，失利才说明我们not行。

core_conflict.wish: 渴望被团队与他人认可，not让任何人失望
core_conflict.fear: Fears being seen as a failure or weak, worried that another loss will be judged by others
defense_goal: 通过维持极高标准来避免失败
Reduces the risk of being judged by avoiding self-exposure

object_relations.self_representation: 让我人失望的、not够好的失败者
object_relations.object_representation: Others/the team who hold high expectations of me and may judge me

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: 当需要向朋友或家人谈论自己的Anxiety与失望情绪时
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: 来访者倾向于认为他人not会理解自己，并会把她看作软弱的人（移情：将Self-denialProjection到他人的评价上）
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: use模糊、谨慎的语气，避免深入谈论感受，转而描述比赛结果或压力来源，减少自我暴露。

manifestations: 因对比赛的Anxiety而撤退社交，难以与队友、朋友和家人讨论失望与Anxiety
担心被视为软弱而选择not分享内心感受
outcomes: 社交疏离与Increased sense of isolation

manifestations: Views 'the season is ruined' as an overall failure, finding it hard to see existing positivity and value
对舞蹈的乐趣显著下降

contact_model.definition: The individual attributes feelings they find hard to accept to others, corresponding to 'possession'. Language manifestations include: 'He is looking down on me', 'They want to exclude me', and so on
manifestations: Believing others will see me as weak, therefore avoiding expressing vulnerability
When talking about emotions, focuses more on others' possible views than on one's own experience

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact, corresponding to 'autonomy'. Language manifestations include: 'It is all my fault that he was hurt', 'I do not deserve to talk to him', and so on
manifestations: 对自身表现过度苛责，认为“not够好、该做得更多”
Being careful in relationships, reducing self-exposure to avoid being judged

positive_force: Still maintains first place in overall ranking; objectively there are positive results and an ability foundation
Has a group of close teammates who can serve as potential support
Proactively seeks counseling and help; has willingness to change
Has tried focusing on the positive and practicing mindfulness, with some self-help attempts
negative_force: Catastrophizing and black-and-white thinking are prominent
Overly concerned about others' evaluations; worries about being seen as weak
对not yet来比赛的预测性担忧（跳到结论）
Social avoidance and withdrawal，导致睡眠与Academics affected

target_behavior.behavior: 赛前及相关谈论中的过度Anxiety与灾难化担忧
antecedent: 练习时被提醒比赛表现
target_behavior.core_reason: 对维持连胜的压力与自我价值绑定（not赢=失败者），以及对再度失利的预测性担忧
target_behavior.function: Escapes the threat of failure and being judged, gaining a temporary sense of control and mental preparedness
target_behavior.consequence: Impaired sleep and attention、Low mood，Declining academic performance

target_behavior.behavior: Social avoidance（避免与队友、朋友、家人谈论情绪与困扰）
antecedent: 想到他人可能认为自己软弱时
Situations needing to share inner feelings or seek support
target_behavior.core_reason: 担心被视为软弱或让他人失望，将Self-denialProjection到他人评价上
target_behavior.function: 避免被负面评价和羞耻感，维持Self-protection的边界
target_behavior.consequence: 社交疏离与Increased sense of loneliness，Anxiety维持甚至加重
